label: Who is Erick?
question: Who is Erick?
answer:
You're talking to an AI hooked up to an MCP version of me — public notes, projects, the stuff I'd actually tell a stranger.

I'm Erick Osterloh. Computer Science at Colorado College (2024–2028, 3.8 GPA), studying abroad in Copenhagen for Fall 2026. I interned at Google on agentic analytics over conversion pipelines, and at PayNearMe on RAG and evals. Right now I build local inference (`infer` on a DGX Spark), long-running research harnesses (`lab` / TinyTrains), from-scratch PyTorch language models, and that personal MCP. Outside CS, I play hoops and golf (11.7 handicap).

label: My work
question: My work
answer:
**Google** SWE intern, Summer 2026 — agents, databases, C++, SQL. Debugging dashboard cut conversion-upload latency ~95%. Agentic insights over ~2.1M customers / ~3.5B conversions a day. Multi-agent customer-issue investigator over petabyte-scale data cut root-cause investigation time ~75%.

**PayNearMe**, Summer 2025 — RAG on LlamaIndex (+67% retrieval via reranking and query rephrasing), evals and tracing with RAGAS and Arize Phoenix, plus ~20 product tickets.

Things I ship:
- [lab](https://github.com/eosterloh/lab) (TinyTrains) — RSI auto-research harness. 8M-parameter Llama-style model: Eval → Research → Train on TinyStories under a 3.5-day budget. Research stays in a sandbox; promotion is gated on a frozen holdout (`confirm_ppl`) the agent cannot touch.
- [infer](https://github.com/eosterloh/infer) — local Python/CUDA inference engine. Drop in `config.json` and weights, get tokens out with HuggingFace logit parity, JSON-schema constrained decode, and custom NVFP4/FP8/Mamba/MoE kernels on DGX Spark.
- Personal MCP — public and private context server so any MCP agent can reason with grounded context.
- [Pixel Watch CNN](https://github.com/eosterloh/WearOSJava) — golf swing detection CNN trained on 10M+ accelerometer, gyro, and heart-rate points from my own swing.

Languages: Python, C++, Java, C, JavaScript, Go (plus SQL and Ruby on Rails). Stack: agents, harnesses, RAG, PyTorch, TensorFlow, CUDA/inference optimization, databases.
